method: Read-only Blender glTF import of final meshes; world-space BVH nearest-surface/ray-parity tests, welded solid topology, assigned-tie containment using actual circular-bar cross-sections, and radius-aware dense line sweeps. No model saved. Final component-ID metadata correction is independently proven geometry-equivalent by whole-file SHA reconstruction.

limitations: Finite-sample geometric audit, not an exact continuous solid Boolean proof. All final tie-mesh vertices and <=25 mm centreline interpolation sampled; ordinary bars sampled at 147 stations and ducts at 1200 segment intervals.
Closed teaching loops omit physical bend radii, hooks, development/anchorage length and binding details. Contact within 0.01 mm is treated as tangency, not negative clearance.
Minimum positive geometric gaps do not certify construction clear spacing. No load cases, steel quantity adequacy, crack control, fatigue, strength or full reinforcement design verified.
Duct meshes represent outer void envelopes, not actual strands. End anchor blocks are only illustrative and are excluded from reinforcement/concrete cover assessment.
